_note: 素材来源记录。同目录 male-idle.png 是 flux 生成后抠白底、按既有女性素材的画布规格（720×980、内容高 948、底对齐）排版的男性讲解员，用于 figureImage。

source.prompt: 3D clay render style character, cute stylized male pediatrician, short black hair, white doctor coat over light blue shirt, stethoscope around neck, front view, half body from waist up, standing with arms relaxed down, friendly gentle smile, soft studio lighting, clean smooth plasticine look, plain pure white background, no text, no props, no shadow on floor.
